cases.name: Susan Kathleen Schumake
cases.about: She was a student at Southern Illinois University Carbondale and studying radio-television.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; CODIS / DNA MATCH; PRISON PAROLEE / ON PROBATION
cases.narrative: On 8/18/1981, her body was found lying facedown in the underbrush alongside a local off-campus trail, used as a shortcut, called Ho Chi Minh on the campus of Southern Illinois in Carbondale, IL. She was wearing a hoodie and wedged shoes, but her underwear and pants had been removed and were lying in a pile near her body.
